description: This file implements the server-side stub and client proxy for the IUnknown interface within the Thunder namespace. It handles reference counting, interface querying, and proxy registration for remote procedure calls.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Stub class handling incoming IPC messages for IUnknown, managing reference counting and interface querying.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class providing client-side access to the IUnknown interface, including identification and shutdown functionality.

classes.name: UnknownInstantiation
classes.description: Static class responsible for registering and deregistering the IUnknown interface with the RPC administrator.

methods.name: UnknownStub::Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming IPC messages based on method index, performing AddRef, Release, or QueryInterface operations.

methods.name: UnknownProxy::Id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the proxy's communication channel.

methods.name: UnknownProxy::Shutdown
methods.description: Closes the communication channel to shut down the proxy.
